title: Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023
what_it_is: Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023

sections.label: Estimates debate guillotine times
sections.summary: The passage states totals for each Head of Expenditure are taken from the Command Paper, 639 amendments were submitted, and guillotine times considered Sitting changes.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: For convenience, I shall take the totals for each Head of Expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates as they appear in the last columns of the schedules of estimated expenditure under the Main and Development Estimates Outlays for FY 2022 on pages 6 and 7 respectively of the Command Paper.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: A total of 639 amendments to the Estimates of Expenditure have been submitted this year.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: The guillotine times to the discussion of the Heads of Expenditure under Standing Order 92(7)(a) have taken into consideration the earlier commencement time of a Sitting, the reduction of Question Time and the extension of Sitting times of the Committee of Supply for each allotted day.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I must remind hon Members that the total time for discussion of each Head of Expenditure includes the replies from the front bench.
